My experience with Craigshill Medical Practice has been consistently poor and deeply frustrating.

Administrative staff are dismissive and appear focused on ending calls as quickly as possible rather than resolving patient concerns. Basic requests require repeated follow-ups, and it often feels necessary to argue or submit formal complaints simply to have routine matters processed.

Communication is ineffective, and there is a lack of accountability when issues are raised. I submitted a formal complaint, yet the response from the practice management was inadequate and failed to address the substance of the concerns. There was no meaningful investigation, no clear explanation, and no improvement in service.

Patients should not have to chase, escalate, and persist to this extent to receive standard care or administrative support. The overall approach feels unprofessional and unresponsive.

Given the lack of resolution through the practice’s internal complaints process, I am now escalating the matter to the Scottish Public Services Ombudsman.
